project_name: Northern Data Maysville HPC data center
aliases: Northern Data Group Maysville data center
status_detail: Northern Data announced a 63-acre Maysville, Georgia HPC/AI data center expected to deliver 120 MW near-term, expandable to 180 MW, and be fully operational in Q1 2027; Maysville spans Banks and Jackson counties and city materials refer to Jackson/Banks.
notes: Capacity may expand to 180 MW. City of Maysville January 2025 meeting PDFs surfaced in search snippets as conditional-use approval for two new Northern Data buildings; direct PDF fetch was blocked/empty in this run, so the company release is the strongest accessible source.

status_detail: Georgia DCA DRI #4061, submitted by City of Cartersville on 2023-08-29, describes development of 126 acres with a single data center facility about 1,620 ft long plus driveways, detention ponds, and an electrical substation; initial form lists phase completion Q2 2026 and overall project 2046.
notes: DCA Part 2 lists Bartow County water/wastewater provider and 1.3 MGD estimated water demand; capacity MW not provided in the accessible DCA fields.

status_detail: Georgia DCA DRI #4403, submitted by Bartow County on 2025-02-14 and completed, describes a six-building data center totaling 2,274,000 sq ft at coordinates 34.30926, -84.96325, with estimated completion 12/2031.
notes: DCA Part 2 estimates $4.5B build-out value, 0.015 MGD water demand, no wastewater flow, and closed-loop technology referenced in the initial filing; power demand not provided.

status_detail: Georgia DCA DRI #4433, submitted by Bartow County on 2025-03-31 and completed, describes a new 8,675,000 sq ft data center development on Taff Road south of Hwy 113 with estimated completion in 2035.
notes: DCA Part 2 estimates $19B build-out value, $40M-$50M annual property tax before incentives, 0.625 MGD water and wastewater demand; energy supplier/load fields were not completed in the accessible form.

status_detail: Georgia DCA DRI #4761, submitted by City of Cartersville on 2026-06-19 and completed, describes a 200 +/- MW critical IT load data center at 218 Industrial Park Road on about 69 acres with about 1,100,000 sq ft floor area and approximate completion in 2032.
notes: DCA Part 2 estimates $2.4B build-out value, about 60 FTEs, requested connected utility load supply of 288 +/- MW, 0.005 MGD water demand, and 0.002 MGD wastewater.
